modules.name: tb_road_postprocess_joint
modules.description: C2 decode/TopK and C9 serial NMS joint simulation testbench; not synthesizable.

reset.name: i_rstn
reset.values: Reset clears both frozen RTL blocks, the controlled LUT endpoint, and temporary scoreboard state.

behavior: Streams exactly 12096 saved 112-bit head words into C2, uses C2's sole internal candidate RAM, and directly connects the sealed/read/response/finish handshakes to C9.
Provides one controlled outstanding sigmoid/exp lookup and compares every accepted FINAL97 entry with the frozen golden table.
Measures start-to-seal, seal-to-last-entry/done, start-to-last-entry/done, C2 phase counters, and mutually exclusive C9 phase occupancy with true stall subcounts.
constraints: The checker may store expected FINAL97 words but does not instantiate a second functional candidate RAM.
This testbench does not include the production C8 collector, CNN inference, synthesis, timing closure, bitstream, board, or Flash operations.
The 2000000-cycle limit applies only to decode plus TopK plus NMS; 100000000 cycles remains a whole-frame planning allowance.
corner_cases: empty table, inclusive threshold, cross-class identical boxes, same-class suppression, 128 candidates per class, 64 outputs, 992 and 6944 NMS comparisons
random input/LUT/output stalls, at least 128 cycles of output backpressure, consecutive real then empty frames
reset in scan/sort/decode/NMS multiply/held output and response error after an accepted entry followed by cancel and full rerun
verification_cases: Seven saved head streams in normal and randomized modes, one consecutive-frame run, five reset/recovery runs, one late-error cancel/recovery run, and one long-backpressure run.
Every successful run checks all FINAL97 entries, frame token, counts, finish readiness, stable held handshakes, seal-time RAM write freeze, and the 2000000-cycle postprocess allowance.

timing_diagrams.title: C2 to C9 direct joint flow
timing_diagrams.description: The sealed handshake transfers ownership to NMS; candidate reads return through C2, FINAL97 may stall, and done is accepted by C2 finish in the same cycle.
